comments:
[8H6M69W4] does not list any item with the signature "phyi la 182."
Contains several short sayings (some not longer than two lines), all ascribed to bTsun pa thogs med, and composed in most cases at dNgul chu'i chos rdzong and dPal e. Some could be identified as the introductory and closes verses of the author's works, notably:

fol. 1b1-2b2: theg pa chen po mdo sde'i brgyan gyi 'grel pa rin po che'i phreng ba

2b2-3a7: theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa nges don gsal bar byed pa'i 'od zer. Up to 3a4, the text corresponds to that in (ID:5074) up to fol. 2a2, then 3a4 to 3a7 correspond to (ID:5074) from fol. 64b8. 

The work on the dPyod 'jug suggested in the title on the cover page is yet to be located.
